title: Steel Mezzanine Floors in Pakistan | Steel Mind
description: Fabrication and erection of steel mezzanine floors for factories, stores and showrooms in Pakistan. Built to your load and layout.
h1: Steel Mezzanine Floors in Pakistan: Fabricated and Erected to Your Load
quickAnswer: A steel mezzanine floor adds usable area inside an existing or new building. Steel Mind designs, fabricates and erects the columns, beams, deck and stairs. It built a 32,400 square foot floor for Haier and a 7,020 square foot floor for Maria B.
alt: Large steel mezzanine floor inside a factory in Pakistan.

faq.q: How long does a mezzanine take to build?
faq.a: It depends on the area. The engineer will give a schedule with the quote.

faq.q: Can the floor be removed later?
faq.a: Yes. Bolted steel mezzanines can be taken apart.

blocks.text: This page covers mezzanine floors as stand-alone steel work, for existing buildings, for concrete buildings and for new buildings of any type. For mezzanines inside a new PEB, see Mezzanine System.
A mezzanine adds floor area without a new building. Factories use them for offices and light assembly. Warehouses use them for small-item picking. Showrooms use them for display and meetings.
Steel Mind designs the columns, beams and deck, fabricates them in Lahore and erects the floor on site. It can also add the staircase, the handrails and the access gate. See Steel Stairs.

Steel Mind built a mezzanine floor of 32,400 square feet for Haier at Raiwind, 12 feet high, 180 feet wide and 180 feet long. It also built a PEB mezzanine floor of 7,020 square feet for Maria B in Lahore, 12 feet high, 90 feet wide and 78 feet long.

blocks.title: What to Send for a Quote

blocks.text: Send the floor area, the height between floors, the use and the heaviest load. Send a sketch of the existing building if there is one.
